name: sent
summary: sent — suckless plain-text presentation tool (drw rebuilt over SDL+freetype2+libpng; .sent decks) + the demo deck

slides.content:
#!/bin/sh
# sent opens deck image refs relative to the CWD, so present the bundled
# demo from the package's share/ dir — the cd is load-bearing, do not
# drop it. Self-location is a known-prefix probe (todos/0444): /opt/sent
# installed, /usr/opt/sent baked; `[` is a hush builtin — zero spawns
# (the old dirname-of-realpath command substitution cost four processes).
pkg=/opt/sent
[ -d "$pkg" ] || pkg=/usr/opt/sent
cd "$pkg/share" && ../sent demo.sent
